Dear Students,

Several students reach out to VentureLab Thapar to discuss startup ideas,
seek advice, or simply ask questions about entrepreneurship. Many times, we
have not always been able to meet everyone individually, and we realize
many more questions never reach us at all.

Is this idea worth pursuing? How do I find a co-founder? Should I start now
or wait? What if I have no idea but am simply curious about
entrepreneurship? These are exactly the conversations we want to have.

So, we are starting VentureLab Student Connect, an initiative where
students can simply walk in and talk about entrepreneurship.

There is no presentation, no workshop, and no formal agenda. Bring your
startup ideas, questions, doubts, experiences—or just your curiosity.

If entrepreneurship has been somewhere in your mind, come over. No
preparation required.

We would love to know what Thapar University students are thinking about
entrepreneurship and where we can enable them better.


Cheers,
